name: Minazuki Satsuki
source:
"The dead are far better than the living who can speak."

The protagonist. An employee of the funeral parlor "Snowlight Funeral Home." He has an aversion to the living, and feels more at home with the dead. On the surface he has a quiet and serious personality. He also has an indifferent and lethargic side to things

Can sense the "smell" of death.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1667316577581289475]
